decisions.reason: Outpatient sociotherapy draws directly on the firm's existing psychiatric and social care expertise, and its move to the home page in 2024 signals that management understands and values its early results.
Counseling for senior living fits the firm's core residential care knowledge, which lets it interpret demand and refine the service, and it has stayed on the home page for both years.

The retail shop extends the existing sheltered workshop, so the firm can assimilate the retail learning, and its promotion to the home page in 2024 shows growing commitment, even though retail lies further from the core than care services.

Meal delivery for seniors builds on the firm's existing catering and elder care routines, but as a recent launch that is only mentioned on the website and faces logistics competition, its future is less certain than that of the core-near services.
